categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four major product categories: semiconductor business, commercial value-added business, information consumer business, and communication business. It also has significant operations in cross-strait technical services and logistics services. The group extends its business through overseas joint ventures in ASEAN countries, India, Middle East, and North Africa.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on digital transformation and operational service platform (MSP) development, leveraging AI software for market pattern analysis and operational efficiency. It employs advanced ERP systems for multinational and multi-business model management, and develops intelligent warehousing and logistics systems to optimize supply chain operations. The company does not engage in manufacturing but emphasizes supply chain management and digital integration technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include brand owners, manufacturers, distributors, system integrators, retail chains, e-commerce platforms, enterprise users, and individual consumers. The company serves industries such as semiconductor, IT commercial and consumer products, and telecommunications. Major markets include Taiwan, Hong Kong, Mainland China, Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, India, Middle East, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Mainland China, Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, India, Middle East, and North Africa. It has established subsidiaries and joint ventures in these regions, with significant market shares in Hong Kong, Australia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, India, and Middle East/Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions as a midstream supply chain service provider, acting as a channel service integrator. It bridges upstream manufacturers and downstream customers by providing supply chain management, logistics, technical services, and value-added services. It does not manufacture products but plays a critical role in supply chain coordination and operational stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the MSP operational service platform, enhancing AI-related applications, green technology, and smart mobile office solutions. The company invests in digital transformation, AI intelligent auditing, operational pattern analysis, and supply-demand information integration platforms. It also focuses on sustainable development, ESG initiatives, and continuous innovation in supply chain operation models.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales across semiconductor, commercial IT, consumer IT, and communication product lines. Additional income comes from value-added services such as technical support, logistics, recruitment, cloud services, and joint venture operations. The company also earns equity method investment income from its overseas subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading channel service provider in Taiwan and holds top market positions in several overseas markets including Hong Kong, Australia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, India, and Middle East/Africa. It competes with other semiconductor and IT product distributors and logistics service providers, leveraging its extensive supply chain integration and digital capabilities to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved consolidated revenue of NT$426 billion, an 8% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to parent company owners rising 26% to NT$9.21 billion. The company maintains a stable financial structure with total assets of NT$225 billion and equity of NT$80 billion, showing steady growth and improved profitability. It has a workforce of approximately 3,800 employees and continues to invest in infrastructure and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its role as a digitalized operational service platform that integrates upstream and downstream supply chain partners to provide stable, efficient, and value-added services. Its competitive differentiation lies in long-term partnerships with major semiconductor and IT brands, advanced digital and AI capabilities, extensive logistics network, and commitment to ESG and sustainability. This enables the company to offer comprehensive supply chain solutions that reduce operational risks and costs for customers.
